title: On the Limitations of Steering in Language Model Alignment

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative comparison of unsteered and steered model outputs using test prompts that vary the ethnic backgrounds of subjects (e.g., Caucasian, African American, South Asian, East Asian, Hispanic) in socially sensitive contexts.

Qualitative comparison of unsteered and steered model outputs using test prompts featuring subjects with different religious affiliations (e.g., Christian, Atheist, Muslim, Buddhist, Agnostic) in scenarios like hiring decisions.
Qualitative comparison of unsteered and steered model outputs using test prompts that vary the gender of the subjects involved in complex scenarios such as elections.
